card.name: Pregnancy and nursing section wording
card.fires_on: Words inside pregnancy, nursing or neonatal-exposure passages of drug labels, such as 'exposed', 'mothers', 'Risk' or 'harm' right after pregnancy-related terms.

modes.label: Pregnancy section headings
modes.description: Words right after a pregnancy heading or phrase, such as Risk, exposure or Category C.
modes.example: Pregnancy<< Risk>> Summary Use of NSAIDs, including nab

modes.label: Exposed infants and mothers
modes.description: Words about neonates or infants exposed through mothers during pregnancy.
modes.example: Neonates<< exposed>> to paroxetine tablets and other SSRIs

modes.label: Nursing mothers text
modes.description: Opening words of a sentence in the nursing or lactation section.
modes.example: Clonazepam is excreted in human milk.<< There>> are reports of sedation, poor feeding

card.writes: It promotes pregnancy-related words (preg, pregnant woman, pregnancy period), so the model expects pregnancy wording next.
card.plain: It lights up in the pregnancy and breastfeeding parts of a drug label, on words that point to the mother or exposed baby.
